title: Compliance Administrator - Leading Recruitment Company
description:
Join Prospero Teaching - Where Passion Meets Purpose in Education!

For over 20 years, Prospero Teaching has been a trusted leader in connecting teaching and support staff with schools, academies, and nurseries across the UK and internationally. We proudly offer our services to a broad range of educational settings, including EYFS, Primary, Secondary, Further Education, SEN, and PRUs.

About the Role

As a Compliance Administrator, you will be a key member of our compliance team, responsible for ensuring candidates meet the necessary regulatory and internal requirements to work within the education sector. You will play a vital role in maintaining compliance with industry standards and fostering a smooth recruitment process for candidates.

Key Responsibilities
- Collaborate with the compliance team to ensure candidates meet all compliance standards for the education sector.
- Follow established operational processes and procedures to ensure adherence to regulations and industry standards.
- Guide and support candidates throughout the recruitment process.
- Conduct compliance checks, including but not limited to right-to-work, DBS, reference, and employment history verifications.
- Maintain and update accurate candidate records.
- Organise and verify candidate documentation.
- Respond to both internal and external inquiries efficiently and professionally.

About You

We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented individual with:
- A good general education (minimum GCSEs in Maths and English, grades A-C, or equivalent).
- Strong relationship-building skills.
- The ability to work effectively under deadlines.
- Excellent administrative and organizational abilities, with a talent for prioritizing tasks.
- Strong communication and customer service skills.
- An understanding of confidentiality and data protection.
- A proactive problem-solving mindset.
- A commitment to safeguarding practices.

Benefits
- Competitive salary with a commission structure.
- Ongoing training and opportunities for professional development.
- Clear career advancement prospects within the company.
- A dynamic and collaborative work environment.
- Private healthcare.
- Quarterly performance-based incentives.

Join us and be part of a team that's helping drive one of the UK's fastest-growing recruitment firms forward.

title: HR Assistant
description:
Are you looking to build your career in Human Resources and gain hands-on experience within a busy and supportive HR team?

Our client, a well-established organisation based in Havant, Hampshire is seeking an HR Assistant to join their team on a permanent basis. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with previous HR administration experience, but it would also suit a recent HR graduate or an individual studying towards a CIPD qualification who is looking to develop practical HR experience across a broad range of activities.

Working as part of a friendly and collaborative team, you will play a key role in supporting day-to-day HR operations whilst gaining exposure to recruitment, onboarding, employee relations, absence management, HR reporting and compliance.

What will the HR Assistant role involve?
- Providing administrative support across a variety of HR activities, including recruitment, absence management and employee development
- Maintaining accurate employee records, HR databases and compliance documentation in line with GDPR requirements and employment legislation
- Supporting the onboarding process and helping to deliver a positive experience for new starters
- Assisting with employee benefits administration, attendance monitoring and HR reporting
- Producing and analysing HR data to support business decision-making
- Acting as a key point of contact between HR and wider business teams, helping to promote a positive and compliant workplace culture

Suitable Candidate for the HR Assistant vacancy:
- Previous experience within an HR Administrator or HR Assistant role would be advantageous
- A qualification in HR, Business, Psychology or a related discipline would be beneficial
- Strong organisational skills with excellent attention to detail
- Effective written and verbal communication skills
- Confidence using Microsoft Office applications and HR systems
- A proactive approach with a genuine willingness to learn and develop
- A keen interest in building a long-term career within Human Resources

Additional benefits and information:
- Salary of up to £30,000 per annum, depending on skills and experience
- Hybrid working arrangement
- Exposure to a broad range of HR activities and projects
- Supportive and collaborative working environment
- Excellent opportunity to develop a career within HR
- Early finish on Fridays
- Flexible working arrangements
- On-site parking
- Comprehensive benefits package

This is a fantastic opportunity to join a welcoming organisation that is committed to supporting professional development and providing valuable experience across all aspects of HR. Whether you are already working within HR administration or looking to take your first step into the profession, we would be keen to hear from you.

CMA Recruitment Group is acting as a recruitment agency in relation to this role. CMA complies with all relevant UK legislation and doesn t discriminate on any protected characteristics. By completing the application process, you agree to the terms outlined in our Privacy Notice and that CMA may contact you in connection with your application in relation to CMA providing you with work finding services. Our Privacy Notice can be viewed under the privacy tab on our website. CMA is currently receiving a high volume of applications. Whilst we ensure all applications are considered, regrettably, it may not be possible to respond individually to all applications received.

title: HR Coordinator
description:
Join a growing and people-focused organisation where you can make a real impact as part of a supportive HR team. This is an excellent opportunity for an organised and proactive HR professional to develop their career while supporting the delivery of a positive employee experience across the business.

Working closely with the Head of People, you will provide support across the full employee lifecycle, from recruitment and onboarding through to HR administration, employee relations and people initiatives. If you enjoy a varied role, building relationships and helping create a great place to work, this could be the perfect opportunity.

Job Title: HR Coordinator

Job Type: Permanent

Location: Hampshire

Salary: £34,000 - £37,000

Benefits: Hybrid working, professional development opportunities and excellent benefits package

Reference no: 16176

HR Coordinator About The Role

As an HR Coordinator, you will play a key role in supporting day-to-day HR operations, ensuring employees receive a professional and efficient service throughout their employment journey. This is a varied position offering exposure to all aspects of HR while working closely with managers and employees across the business. Main Responsibilities
- Coordinate recruitment activities, including advertising roles, arranging interviews and supporting hiring managers.
- Manage onboarding processes, preparing contracts, offer letters and induction materials.
- Maintain accurate employee records and HR systems.
- Provide first-line support for HR-related queries.
- Support payroll administration and employee benefits processes.
- Assist with absence management, probation reviews and employee relations administration.
- Coordinate learning and development activities and maintain training records.
- Produce HR reports and support people-focused projects and initiatives.
- Ensure HR processes remain compliant with company policies and employment legislation.

The Successful Candidate Will Have
- Previous experience within an HR Administrator, HR Assistant or HR Coordinator role.
- A good understanding of HR processes and best practice.
- Ideally CIPD Level 3 qualified or studying towards a qualification.
- Strong organisational skills and excellent attention to detail.
- Confidence communicating with stakeholders at all levels.
- Experience using HR systems and managing confidential information.
- A proactive approach and the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively

Howett Thorpe are acting as a recruitment agency in relation to this role and comply with all relevant UK legislation and do not discriminate on any protected characteristics. Due to the high volume of applications we receive, we are unable to respond to all candidates. If you do not hear from a Consultant within 5 working days, please assume your application has not been successful.

Refer a Friend

If this role is not right for you but may suit someone you know, refer them to us and receive a minimum of £100 in vouchers for a successful permanent placement or £25 in vouchers for a temporary placement (terms and conditions apply).

title: HR Coordinator
description:
Job Title: HR Coordinator

Location: Chineham Business Park, Basingstoke with hybrid working after probation. Some travel to client sites on occasion across London and the Southeast

Salary: £24,000 per year plus benefits and profit-related bonus

Job Type: Permanent, Full-Time - Hybrid Working 30 hours per week

Looking for variety, flexibility and a genuinely supportive team?

Are you an experienced HR Coordinator or Administrator who enjoys building relationships, solving problems and making a real difference to businesses?

At Reality HR, we've been helping organisations navigate people challenges, develop their leaders and create thriving workplaces for over 20 years. As our business continues to grow, we're looking for an HR Coordinator to join our client-facing team.

The role offers exceptional variety. As part of our HR Coordinator team, you'll provide high-quality HR coordination and administrative support to both our clients and internally to the Reality HR team, ensuring HR processes are delivered accurately, efficiently and in line with agreed service standards. No two days are the same.

When supporting our clients with outsourced HR administration your responsibilities will include:
- payroll administration,
- HR Information Systems management and reporting (experience of PeopleHR, BreatheHR, HiBob, would be advantageous although training will be provided)
- creating appropriate documentation to support HR processes including joiners and leavers, background checks, performance and absence management, variation to pay and contracts
- conducting exit interviews
- notetaking at HR meetings
- reviewing and updating employment contracts and policies
- managing client email inboxes and answering client queries directly where appropriate
- collaborate with colleagues to deliver an exceptional client experience

About you:

You'll be an experienced HR administrator who enjoys building relationships, solving problems and working at pace.

You'll bring:
- CIPD qualification to Level 3 or above, or equivalent work experience and knowledge
- Good understanding of HR administration and employee lifecycle processes
- Understanding of data protection and confidentiality requirements
- Proficiency in Microsoft 365, Office and business systems
- Awareness of UK employment law and HR best practice with a willingness and ability to develop knowledge in this area
- A strong focus on quality and accuracy, with a commitment to delivering exceptional client service
- Confidence producing work independently while remaining a collaborative team player
- Ability to prioritise workload and work to deadlines
- Previous consultancy experience would be advantageous but is not essential.

Reality HR is a fast-paced environment where priorities can change quickly, so you'll need to be adaptable, organised and comfortable managing a varied workload. In return, you'll be supported by an experienced team who genuinely care about one another and work together to achieve great outcomes for our clients.

Whether you're looking to build a long-term career as an HR Coordinator or develop towards becoming an HR Advisor or Consultant in the future, we'll support you to achieve your own professional goals. Progression opportunities are available for those who want them, but they're never an expectation.

Why join Reality HR?

People are at the heart of everything we do, including our own team. We know our people are the reason for our success.

We are proud of our supportive culture, where colleagues work together, share knowledge openly and genuinely care about each other's success and wellbeing. Our team works hard to deliver outstanding service to clients, but we are equally committed to maintaining flexibility, work-life balance and creating an environment where people can thrive.

Our culture is reflected in our employee engagement results, including an eNPS score of 70.

We're a close-knit team of 26 colleagues and part of the wider Shaw Gibbs Group, giving us the benefits of a supportive independent consultancy combined with the opportunities and stability of a larger organisation.

You'll enjoy:
- Genuine variety working with organisations across multiple sectors
- Exposure to a wide range of HR tasks and projects
- The opportunity to develop advisory and consultancy skills and broaden your commercial experience
- Support for CIPD development and ongoing learning
- Career progression opportunities for those who wish to pursue them
- A collaborative, knowledgeable and highly supportive team
- Flexibility and hybrid working arrangements
- A culture that values both high performance and work-life balance

Benefits:
- 22 days holiday, increasing to 25 days after one year
- Profit-related bonus scheme
- Company sick pay when you or your dependants are ill
- Paid CIPD membership and professional development support
- Health cash plan, wellbeing benefits and Employee Assistance Programme
- Reward Gateway discounts across hundreds of retailers
- Hybrid working arrangements
- Free parking
- Modern offices with breakout spaces
- Regular team events and social events for those that want them

Candidates with the experience or relevant job titles of: HR Administrator, Human Resources Administrator, HR Assistant, Human Resources Assistant, may also be considered for this role.

title: Internal Recruiter
description:
At CV-Library, we have a simple vision: to help the world to work and we are looking for exceptional and talented people to help us realise this vision in both UK and overseas markets.

We are in a period of focused internal investment, following a year of key strategic acquisitions and significant investment across all parts of the business from Tech and Data to People and HR, there's never been a more exciting time to join us or a better place to grow your career!

Hours: Monday-Friday, 9:00-17:30
Location: Fleet, Hampshire
Working Pattern: Hybrid - 3 days a week on site

We're now looking for an Internal Recruiter to join us and take ownership of the full recruitment lifecycle across a diverse range of roles and business functions. Working closely with hiring managers, you'll attract, engage and hire top talent through a proactive, data-driven approach, helping to shape our workforce while delivering an exceptional candidate experience from attraction through to onboarding.

Key Responsibilities:
- Take full ownership of the end-to-end recruitment process across the CV-Library Group, advising hiring managers on requirements, salary expectations, timelines and the current candidate market
- Partner with hiring managers to understand hiring needs and agree recruitment strategies, particularly for hard to fill and specialist roles using data and market insight to identify trends, improve hiring activity and support better recruitment decisions
- Source, screen and assess candidates across a variety of business functions
- Build and maintain talent pipelines for current and future recruitment requirements
- Proactively source candidates using CV-Library, LinkedIn, employee referrals, talent pools, networking and other direct sourcing methods to attract high-quality talent
- Coordinate interviews, assessments and candidate communications, maintaining accurate recruitment data, reporting and ATS records
- Manage offer processes, negotiations and onboarding handovers and day-1 inductions
- Provide an exceptional candidate experience at every stage of the hiring journey
- Identify candidates who have the right skills, experience and alignment with CV-Library's values
- Manage relationships with recruitment agencies and external suppliers
- Support employer brand and talent attraction activity to help increase awareness of the CV-Library Group as an employer, including promotion and administration of the employee referral programme
- Monitor and report upon recruitment activity and key metrics, including time to hire, source of hire, offer acceptance and agency spend
- Work closely with HR and hiring managers to support workforce planning and upcoming recruitment requirements
- Ensure all recruitment practices are fair, compliant and meet company policies and employment legislation

Skills & Experience:
- Previous recruitment experience gained within an internal acquisition team or recruitment agency environment
- Proven experience managing multiple vacancies and delivering successful hires across a range of disciplines and seniority levels
- Strong candidate sourcing skills, including the use of job boards, LinkedIn, talent pools, referrals and networking techniques
- Experience partnering with hiring managers to understand requirements and provide recruitment advice
- Experience recruiting for hard-to-fill or specialist roles using proactive sourcing and headhunting techniques
- Good understanding of the recruitment market, including salary expectations, candidate availability and sourcing trends
- Experience using recruitment data and reporting to track performance and identify areas for improvement
- Experience conducting candidate screenings and assessing suitability against role requirements
- Ability to build strong relationships with hiring managers, candidates and other stakeholders
- Excellent communication, organisation and time management skills
- Experience using Application Tracking Systems (ATS), CRM systems or other recruitment technologies

We are actively committed to promoting a fully diverse and inclusive workforce and we welcome applications for this role from all candidates who meet the key requirements.

Please do not hesitate to get in touch should you require any reasonable adjustments to assist with your application.

title: Recruitment Resourcer
description:
Prospero Group has been successfully placing teaching and support staff for over 20 years. Our network of schools, academies, and nurseries spans the UK and international markets. Our educational services are available in a wide range of educational settings; EYFS, Primary, Secondary, Further Education, SEN, and PRUs.

Looking for a career that offers meaningful work and a chance to make a difference?

At Prospero Group, you'll have the opportunity to build strong relationships with schools and teaching staff, while also reaching for the stars in terms of targets and commission. With a supportive team environment, excellent commission rates, and plenty of room for personal growth, this is a chance to join a company that truly values its people.

Prospero Group are delighted to be recruiting a Recruitment Resourcer to join our Southampton team!

In this role you will be responsible for-
- Conducting telephone interviews with prospective candidates to establish suitability for various roles
- Advertising vacancies on job boards within company guidelines
- Sourcing candidates via social media, job boards, CV searching, and our branch network
- Working with the team to coordinate each stage from initial application through to offer of employment
- Supporting with candidate mailers
- Data entry/ administration

What we are looking for-
- Driven, hungry and motivated individuals with a 'winning' attitude!
- Willingness to learn
- Strong written and communication skills
- Positive and 'can do' attitude
- Graduate or equivalent desirable
- Competitive and target driven

Experience within a similar role is desirable.

You must be able to demonstrate a proven track record in your field, whether it be in work, education, or sport! We are always looking for individuals with the hard-working mindset that is looking to apply themselves to a new challenge.

This is a great opportunity to learn the foundations of recruitment and grow!

What We Offer:
- Industry-leading OTE
- Great holidays plus your birthday off!
- Target-based incentives and rewards
- Career progression based entirely on your personal achievement
- Opportunity to become a team leader or manager very quickly
- Industry-leading training throughout your career
- A culture that motivates, excites and stimulates
- Monthly company social events

If you're ambitious, financially motivated, competitive, and interested in joining a growing business with a group of like-minded people, then Prospero has the career you're looking for!

title: Resourcer
company: Find Recruitment Group LTD - Agency - Permanent
description:
Talent Partner / Resourcer

STEM Education & Training Fareham

FIND is a specialist recruitment business with a simple belief: great recruitment is built on great sales, deep market knowledge and treating people properly. We're relentless about winning, and equally relentless about improving the perception of staffing agencies. That means creating outstanding opportunities for candidates and helping clients secure the talent that makes a difference.

The opportunity

You will build relationships with exceptional people across STEM education and technical training, understand what motivates them and connect them with opportunities that genuinely move their careers forward.

What you will own
- Build and maintain a network of teaching, training and technical education talent.
- Get curious about people: their skills, ambitions, frustrations and what would make them move.
- Find and engage hard-to-reach candidates, not just the people already applying.
- Work closely with our consultants to deliver on client commitments, with pace, accuracy and care.
- Learn to qualify properly, manage expectations and create an outstanding candidate experience.

Who will thrive here

You might be starting your recruitment career, but you won't be starting without a plan. We want energy, curiosity, confidence, empathy and a willingness to do the work others avoid. You will be measured on the quality of the networks you build and the commitments you deliver.

What you get
- Salary depending on experience
- 300 /placement (Talent Partners) & 25% - 35% commission (Consultants)
- 30 days annual leave plus bank holidays
- Christmas shutdown
- Two holiday incentives each year
- Private medical cover after successful six-month probation
- Enhanced pension scheme
- A substantial sales enablement and candidate sourcing tech stack
- Ongoing learning, development and sales coaching
- Four days a week in our Fareham office

title: Resourcer / Delivery Consultant
description:
Resourcer / Delivery Consultant

Transportation and Buildings

Location

Port Solent, Portsmouth

Hours

Monday to Friday, full time, early Friday finish

Salary

Competitive salary plus incentives

Reports to

Department Manager, Transportation and Buildings

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Resourcer or Delivery Consultant to support our Transportation and Buildings teams. The level of the role is matched to your experience.

You will find and engage the right candidates for our consultants' vacancies across highways, rail, building services and construction. It is the ideal foundation for progressing into a full 360 consultant role.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
- Source, screen and shortlist candidates using the CRM, job boards, LinkedIn and your own network
- Recruit engineers, designers, project managers, site managers and building services professionals
- Advertise vacancies and network proactively to build strong talent pools
- Interview candidates to understand their skills and motivations, and match them accurately to roles
- Manage candidates through the process, keeping them informed and engaged
- Handle queries on contracts, pay and logistics
- Keep the CRM accurate, generate call lists and maintain compliance standards
- Deliver against activity KPIs and contribute to team targets

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR
- Confident on the phone, with strong verbal and written communication
- Builds rapport quickly and puts people at ease
- Persuasive, persistent and patient
- Organised, able to prioritise and work to deadlines
- Resilient, flexible and adaptable
- Good IT skills and quick to learn new systems
- Resourcing or recruitment experience in technical markets is an advantage; the right attitude matters most and full training is provided

ABOUT ADVANCE TRS

Advance TRS is an award-winning technical recruitment business specialising in the Built Environment and Infrastructure markets. We are one of the fastest-growing recruitment companies in the UK, with offices in Port Solent (Portsmouth), Guildford and London.

We grew by 40% last year and are on track to do the same again, through organic growth, new offices and strategic acquisitions. We reward success, promote from within and celebrate together as one team.

WHAT WE OFFER

A competitive salary and a rewards package built to recognise performance and support your wellbeing.

Rewards and incentives
- Incentive lunches, vouchers and team activities
- Delivery recognition, including a place on the annual overseas incentive trip for the standout performer
- A clear route into a 360 consultant role
- Long service awards, including experience gifts at 5, 10 and 15 years

Time off and wellbeing
- 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays, rising with service to 30 days
- Birthday day off after one year
- Early Friday finish
- Weekly wellness hour
- Private medical insurance after one year, including private GP and an Employee Assistance Programme
- Enhanced maternity and paternity leave
- Perkbox perks and discounts platform

Financial security
- Company pension with 5% employer contribution
- Life assurance at three times basic salary

Team and culture
- Summer and Christmas parties, days out, golf, go-karting and regular team socials
- Structured training, coaching and clearly defined career paths

HOW TO APPLY

Send your CV to (url removed). For a confidential conversation about the role first, get in touch at the same address.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity in our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
